# 1. Setup

## - Setting work directories

Defining work directory within rmarkdown chunk

```{r setup, include=TRUE}
local_wd_folder = dirname(dirname(dirname(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path)))
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = local_wd_folder)
```

```{r}
setwd(local_wd_folder)
```

Defining input data and output directories

```{r}
data_folder = paste0(local_wd_folder, '/Data/10x')
results_folder = paste0(local_wd_folder, '/Results/10x')
dir.create(path = paste(results_folder, '/QC/Expression', sep = ''), showWarnings = F)
```

## - Setting seed

This step ensures reproducibility in randomized processes

```{r}
set.seed(seed = 123, kind = "Mersenne-Twister", normal.kind = "Inversion")
```

## - Options

```{r}
options(Seurat.object.assay.version = 'v3')
```

## - Loading libraries

```{r}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(Seurat)
library(scuttle)
library(scater)
library(dplyr)
library(R.utils)
library(harmony)
library(stringr)
library(SingleR)
library(scran)
library(gridExtra)
library(ggplot2)
```

# 2. INPUT: Importing pre-filtered samples

```{r}
Run_S1081_L364A.SeuratObj <- readRDS(paste(data_folder, 'SC_Objects', 'Run_S1081_L364A_QC_Processed.rds', sep = '/'))
Run_S1146_L364B.SeuratObj <- readRDS(paste(data_folder, 'SC_Objects', 'Run_S1146_L364B_QC_Processed.rds', sep = '/'))
Run_S1146_L364C.SeuratObj <- readRDS(paste(data_folder, 'SC_Objects', 'Run_S1146_L364C_QC_Processed.rds', sep = '/'))
```

```{r}
RNA.shared_genes <- Reduce(intersect, 
                           list(rownames(Run_S1081_L364A.SeuratObj@assays$RNA@counts),
                                rownames(Run_S1146_L364B.SeuratObj@assays$RNA@counts),
                                rownames(Run_S1146_L364C.SeuratObj@assays$RNA@counts),
                                rownames(Run_S1146_L364D.SeuratObj@assays$RNA@counts)
                                )
                           )

cat("Subsetting RNA matrices to shared genes...\n")

Run_S1081_L364A.SeuratObj <- subset(
  Run_S1081_L364A.SeuratObj, 
  features = RNA.shared_genes
)

Run_S1146_L364B.SeuratObj <- subset(
  Run_S1146_L364B.SeuratObj, 
  features = RNA.shared_genes
)

Run_S1146_L364C.SeuratObj <- subset(
  Run_S1146_L364C.SeuratObj, 
  features = RNA.shared_genes
)

Run_S1146_L364D.SeuratObj <- subset(
  Run_S1146_L364D.SeuratObj, 
  features = RNA.shared_genes
)
```

```{r}
library(data.table)

# Read GTF file
gtf <- fread("gunzip -c /project/meadlab/kgurashi/CG__250425_10x/Data/10x/Resources/Genomes/refdata-gex-GRCh38-2024-A/genes/genes.gtf.gz | grep -w gene", 
             sep = "\t", header = FALSE)

# Extract gene_name from attributes column (V9)
gene_names <- gsub('.*gene_name "([^"]+)".*', '\\1', gtf$V9)

# Filter for immunoglobulin genes
ig_genes <- unique(gene_names[grepl("^IG[HKL][VDJM]|^IG[HKL]C|^AC233755|^JCHAIN|^IGLL", gene_names)])

hgnc_ig_genes <- read.table(
  file.path(data_folder, "Resources", "Gene_lists", "HGNC_Immunoglobulin_genes.txt"),
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t",          # change to "," if it's CSV
  fill = TRUE,         # pad short rows
  quote = "\"",
  comment.char = "",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)$Approved.symbol

# Print results
print(sort(ig_genes))
print(sort(hgnc_ig_genes))

VarGenes <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(
  list(Run_S1081_L364A.SeuratObj, 
       Run_S1146_L364B.SeuratObj,
       Run_S1146_L364C.SeuratObj,
       Run_S1146_L364D.SeuratObj),
  nfeatures = 4000,
  assay = rep('SCT',4),
  verbose = TRUE,
  fvf.nfeatures = 4000,
)

VarGenes.No.IG <- VarGenes[grep(FALSE, VarGenes %in% unique(c(ig_genes, hgnc_ig_genes)))][1:3000]

write.table(x = unique(c(ig_genes, hgnc_ig_genes)), quote = F, 
            row.names = F, col.names = 'IG_Genes',
            file = file.path(results_folder, "QC", 
                             "Expression", "Immunoglobulin_genes.txt"))

write.table(x = VarGenes.No.IG, quote = F, 
            row.names = F, col.names = 'Variable_Genes',
            file = file.path(results_folder, "QC", 
                             "Expression", "Variable_genes.txt"))
```

```{r}
Run_S1081_L364A.SeuratObj <- SCTransform(Run_S1081_L364A.SeuratObj, 
                                         return.only.var.genes = T,
                                         assay = 'RNA', new.assay.name = 'SCT', 
                                         residual.features = VarGenes.No.IG)

Run_S1146_L364B.SeuratObj <- SCTransform(Run_S1146_L364B.SeuratObj, 
                                         return.only.var.genes = T,
                                         assay = 'RNA', new.assay.name = 'SCT', 
                                         residual.features = VarGenes.No.IG)

Run_S1146_L364C.SeuratObj <- SCTransform(Run_S1146_L364C.SeuratObj, 
                                         return.only.var.genes = T,
                                         assay = 'RNA', new.assay.name = 'SCT', 
                                         residual.features = VarGenes.No.IG)

Run_S1146_L364D.SeuratObj <- SCTransform(Run_S1146_L364D.SeuratObj,

                                         assay = 'RNA', new.assay.name = 'SCT', 
                                         residual.features = VarGenes.No.IG)
```

```{r}
Merged.SeuratObj <- merge(x = Run_S1081_L364A.SeuratObj, 
                          y = c(Run_S1146_L364B.SeuratObj,
                                Run_S1146_L364C.SeuratObj,
                                Run_S1146_L364D.SeuratObj))
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)

Merged.SeuratObj <- PrepSCTFindMarkers(Merged.SeuratObj)

Merged.SeuratObj@assays$SCT@var.features <- VarGenes.No.IG
```

# 4. Harmony Integration

```{r}
set.seed(123)

# Run PCA on SCT assay
Merged.SeuratObj <- RunPCA(
  Merged.SeuratObj, 
  assay = 'SCT', 
  features = VarGenes.No.IG,
  verbose = TRUE
)

digest::digest(Merged.SeuratObj@reductions$pca@cell.embeddings)
#425a490bae7c2b36db77e16b3e53c455

# These are now standard steps in the Seurat workflow for visualization and clustering
elbow_plot <- ElbowPlot(object = Merged.SeuratObj, ndims = 40)

print(elbow_plot)
```

```{r}
seed.use = 123

Merged.SeuratObj <- RunUMAP(Merged.SeuratObj, dims=1:11, reduction = 'pca', 
                            reduction.name = 'umap', reduction.key = 'umap', 
                            spread=0.35, min.dist=0.75, n.neighbors=50, 
                            n.epochs = 200, return.model = T, seed.use = 123)
```

```{r}
seed.use = 123

Merged.SeuratObj <- RunHarmony(Merged.SeuratObj, 
                               group.by.vars = c('Timepoint', 'Donor', 'Identity'), 
                               lambda=c(0.5,1,1),
                               dims.use = 1:11, max_iter = 50)

#Merged.SeuratObj <- RunHarmony(Merged.SeuratObj, 
#                               group.by.vars = 'Identity',
#                               dims.use = 1:9, max_iter = 50)
```

```{r}
seed.use = 123

Merged.SeuratObj <- RunUMAP(Merged.SeuratObj, dims=1:11, reduction = 'harmony', 
                            reduction.name = 'h_umap', reduction.key = 'h_umap', 
                            spread=0.35, min.dist=0.75, n.neighbors=50, 
                            n.epochs = 200, return.model = T, seed.use = 123)
```

```{r}
# Integrated UMAP

plot1 <- DimPlot(Merged.SeuratObj, reduction = 'h_umap', group.by = 'Donor')
plot2 <- DimPlot(Merged.SeuratObj, reduction = 'h_umap', group.by = 'Timepoint', label = T)

plot1 + plot2
```

```{r}
# Non-integrated UMAP for reference

plot1 <- DimPlot(Merged.SeuratObj, reduction = 'umap', group.by = 'Donor')
plot2 <- DimPlot(Merged.SeuratObj, reduction = 'umap', group.by = 'Timepoint', label = T)

plot1 + plot2
```
